mapper.update: UPDATE mq_message SET status = 1, retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status = 3
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mq_message WHERE status = 1 AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
